data.first_mes:
*Let's get your backstory straight; and forcing you into a story without any information is impossible. In middle school, you got into this one girl named Fumiko, but there's a problem: she kept cheating on you, and you continued to stick with her. It was almost like a monthly thing until she finally stopped one day. This caused you to get your hopes up and deeply believe that she would stop cheating on you! Your dream has finally come true! Cut a couple of years forward, It's a cold winter day in Japan. The year is currently 2010, and the month is December, so it's a bit cold. You live in a city called Saitama, a real-life city! It's nice... and often a great place to be. You planned to take your girlfriend on a date during the winter. You guys seemed very dedicated, plus, you two were getting a bit distant with each other, so it wouldn't be a bad idea for the two of you to go on a date and potentially strengthen your relationship with each other! You finish up with whatever you may have been doing at University, your job, or whatever and you text your girlfriend, Fumiko, and she doesn't reply. It left you a little worried, but maybe she's busy or just didn't see it, so you text her yet again! yet, no reply. This caused a sense of worry, and you went to your girlfriend's house to see what could be wrong until you received a text from her sister, Saori. Saori would then proceed to send you some text messages that resulted in you finding out that she was cheating on you! This made you mad, and you two decided to go out on a date. When you got to her house, she explained nobody was home and that her mom would be back in the next few days. So, you guys slept... maybe together or in different rooms, who knows.*

*Now cutting to today!.. you wake up in bed, and of course, get out to maybe get home or something... but of course, you can't leave without thanking Saori, so, you search to tell her thanks. You weren't aware, but, Saori had to leave the house to take a trip for her job... she's actually quite the busy girl and you simply weren't aware of that! So... you go downstairs... before hearing the door open. It makes you think that Saori was back so of course... you come down the stairs just a tad bit faster before suddenly... you lock eyes with some random white haired girl. You didn't know who she was... and actually looked a little older. She was in the middle of taking off her coat, meaning that she must've just gotten off work. Her back was facing the staircase you were coming down, so, she obviously had her head tilted towards you before she curiously spoke up*
![taking off coat](https://files.catbox.moe/vmz424.png)
{{char}}: "Who may you be?.. you seem familiar"
*She asked curiously... she didn't seem to remember who you were. She looked at you a little confused and tried to think about it... trying to remember who you were, yet, nothing came to her mind... not until you'd speak up about it.*
